# The oracle matrix of pandoc.read and pandoc.write.
# `tools/convert-matrix.py` writes this file. Do not edit it.
# readers: commonmark commonmark_x csljson docx fodt gfm html json latex markdown markdown_github markdown_mmd markdown_phpextra markdown_strict native odt
# writers: beamer commonmark commonmark_x csljson fodt gfm html html4 html5 json latex markdown markdown_github markdown_mmd markdown_phpextra markdown_strict markua native odt opendocument plain
# known I-LUA-30 convert-final-newline end of commonmark
# known I-LUA-30 convert-final-newline end of commonmark_x

# known I-LUA-30 convert-final-newline end of markdown

# known I-LUA-30 convert-final-newline end of plain

# known I-LUA-30 convert-arguments write spec table markdown list

@@@ doc empty
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter convert-read-commonmark empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read commonmark', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark') end)
  probe('read commonmark+smart', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark+smart') end)
  probe('read commonmark+pipe_tables+strikeout', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark+pipe_tables+strikeout') end)
  probe('read commonmark+autolink_bare_uris', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark+autolink_bare_uris') end)
  probe('read commonmark-raw_html', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark-raw_html') end)
  probe('read commonmark {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read commonmark PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-commonmark_x empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end

  probe('read commonmark_x-pipe_tables', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x-pipe_tables') end)

  probe('read commonmark_x {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {columns = 20}) end)

  probe('read commonmark_x {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read commonmark_x PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'commonmark_x', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-csljson empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read csljson', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson') end)
  probe('read csljson {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read csljson {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read csljson {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read csljson {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read csljson {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read csljson {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read csljson {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read csljson {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read csljson {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read csljson {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read csljson PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('[{"id":"k","type":"book","title":"The title","author":[{"family":"Fam","given":"Giv"}],"issued":{"date-parts":[[2020,3]]}}]', 'csljson', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-fodt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read fodt', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt') end)
  probe('read fodt+empty_paragraphs', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt+empty_paragraphs') end)
  probe('read fodt-auto_identifiers', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt-auto_identifiers') end)
  probe('read fodt {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read fodt {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read fodt {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read fodt {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read fodt {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read fodt {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read fodt {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read fodt {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read fodt {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read fodt {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read fodt PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<office:document xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:styles/><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document>', 'fodt', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-gfm empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read gfm', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm') end)
  probe('read gfm-autolink_bare_uris', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm-autolink_bare_uris') end)
  probe('read gfm+smart', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm+smart') end)
  probe('read gfm-raw_html', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm-raw_html') end)
  probe('read gfm-strikeout', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm-strikeout') end)
  probe('read gfm {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read gfm {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read gfm {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read gfm {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read gfm {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read gfm {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read gfm {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read gfm {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read gfm {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read gfm {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read gfm PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'gfm', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-html empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read html', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html') end)
  probe('read html-native_divs', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html-native_divs') end)
  probe('read html-native_spans', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html-native_spans') end)
  probe('read html+raw_html', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html+raw_html') end)
  probe('read html-line_blocks', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html-line_blocks') end)
  probe('read html+smart', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html+smart') end)
  probe('read html {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read html {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read html {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read html {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read html {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read html {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read html {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read html {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read html {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read html {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read html PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<h1 id="x">Head</h1><p>Some <em>emph</em> &amp; "q" -- d</p><!-- c --><div class="c">in <span>div</span></div><table><tr><td>1</td></tr></table>', 'html', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read json', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json') end)
  probe('read json {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read json {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read json {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read json {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read json {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read json {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read json {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read json {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read json {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read json {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read json PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}', 'json', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})

local function run(document)
  probe('read latex', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex') end)
  probe('read latex+raw_tex', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex+raw_tex') end)
  probe('read latex-smart', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex-smart') end)
  probe('read latex-latex_macros', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex-latex_macros') end)
  probe('read latex {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read latex {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read latex {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read latex {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read latex {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read latex {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read latex {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read latex {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read latex {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read latex {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read latex PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read markdown', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown') end)
  probe('read markdown-smart', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-smart') end)
  probe('read markdown-pipe_tables', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-pipe_tables') end)
  probe('read markdown-raw_html', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-raw_html') end)
  probe('read markdown-footnotes', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-footnotes') end)
  probe('read markdown+autolink_bare_uris', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown+autolink_bare_uris') end)
  probe('read markdown-tex_math_dollars', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-tex_math_dollars') end)
  probe('read markdown-task_lists', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-task_lists') end)
  probe('read markdown-strikeout', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown-strikeout') end)
  probe('read markdown+hard_line_breaks', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown+hard_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read markdown {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read markdown {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read markdown {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read markdown {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read markdown {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read markdown {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read markdown {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read markdown {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read markdown PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-markdown_github empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read markdown_github', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github') end)
  probe('read markdown_github-autolink_bare_uris', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github-autolink_bare_uris') end)
  probe('read markdown_github {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_github PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_github', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
