  probe('read markdown_mmd {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_mmd PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_mmd', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-markdown_phpextra empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra') end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra+smart', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra+smart') end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra-footnotes', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra-footnotes') end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read markdown_phpextra PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_phpextra', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-markdown_strict empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end

  probe('read markdown_strict+pipe_tables', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict+pipe_tables') end)

end

@@@ filter convert-read-native empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read native', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native') end)
  probe('read native {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read native {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read native {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read native {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read native {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read native {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read native {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read native {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read native {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read native {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read native PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-odt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'

  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end

  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('read odt {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000mimetypeapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textPK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000content.xml<office:document-content xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document-content>PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000styles.xml<office:document-styles xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"><office:styles/></office:document-styles>PK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001\000\000\000\000mimetypePK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001M\000\000\000content.xmlPK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001x\001\000\000styles.xmlPK\005\006\000\000\000\000\003\000\003\000\167\000\000\000!\002\000\000\000\000', 'odt', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read odt {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000mimetypeapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textPK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000content.xml<office:document-content xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document-content>PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000styles.xml<office:document-styles xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"><office:styles/></office:document-styles>PK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001\000\000\000\000mimetypePK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001M\000\000\000content.xmlPK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001x\001\000\000styles.xmlPK\005\006\000\000\000\000\003\000\003\000\167\000\000\000!\002\000\000\000\000', 'odt', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read odt {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000mimetypeapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textPK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000content.xml<office:document-content xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document-content>PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000styles.xml<office:document-styles xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"><office:styles/></office:document-styles>PK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001\000\000\000\000mimetypePK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001M\000\000\000content.xmlPK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001x\001\000\000styles.xmlPK\005\006\000\000\000\000\003\000\003\000\167\000\000\000!\002\000\000\000\000', 'odt', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read odt {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000mimetypeapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textPK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000content.xml<office:document-content xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document-content>PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000styles.xml<office:document-styles xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"><office:styles/></office:document-styles>PK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001\000\000\000\000mimetypePK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001M\000\000\000content.xmlPK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001x\001\000\000styles.xmlPK\005\006\000\000\000\000\003\000\003\000\167\000\000\000!\002\000\000\000\000', 'odt', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read odt PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000mimetypeapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textPK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000content.xml<office:document-content xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0" xmlns:text="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0"><office:body><office:text><text:p>OpenDocument</text:p></office:text></office:body></office:document-content>PK\003\004\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000styles.xml<office:document-styles xmlns:office="urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0"><office:styles/></office:document-styles>PK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000^\1982\012\039\000\000\000\039\000\000\000\008\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001\000\000\000\000mimetypePK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\201\161\015\248\002\001\000\000\002\001\000\000\011\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001M\000\000\000content.xmlPK\001\002\020\003\020\000\000\000\000\000\000\000!\000\019C\214\152\129\000\000\000\129\000\000\000\010\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\128\001x\001\000\000styles.xmlPK\005\006\000\000\000\000\003\000\003\000\167\000\000\000!\002\000\000\000\000', 'odt', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-beamer empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write beamer', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write beamer-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write beamer+raw_tex', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer+raw_tex'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write beamer {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write beamer {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write beamer {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'beamer', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-commonmark empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write commonmark {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-commonmark_x empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write commonmark_x', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark_x'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write commonmark_x-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark_x-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write commonmark_x-footnotes', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark_x-footnotes'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write commonmark_x {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark_x', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-csljson empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)

  probe('write csljson {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'csljson', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write csljson PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'csljson', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-fodt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write fodt', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'fodt'); return P.read(bytes, 'fodt') end)
  probe('write fodt+empty_paragraphs', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'fodt+empty_paragraphs'); return P.read(bytes, 'fodt') end)
  probe('write fodt+native_numbering', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'fodt+native_numbering'); return P.read(bytes, 'fodt') end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-gfm empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write gfm', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write gfm-pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm-pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write gfm+smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm+smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write gfm-strikeout', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm-strikeout'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write gfm PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-html empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write html', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'html'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-html4 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write html4', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'html4'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write html4+smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'html4+smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write html4-native_divs', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'html4-native_divs'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-html5 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-json empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write json', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write json {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write json {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write json {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write json {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write json {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'json', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
