end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-latex empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write latex', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write latex {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown-pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown-footnotes', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-footnotes'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write markdown-strikeout', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-strikeout'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown-fenced_divs', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-fenced_divs'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown+hard_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown+hard_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown-header_attributes', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-header_attributes'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write markdown PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_github empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown_github', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_github'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write markdown_github {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_github', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write markdown_github {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_github', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_github {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_github', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_mmd empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown_mmd', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd-pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd-pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd+smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd+smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_phpextra empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown_phpextra', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_phpextra'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write markdown_phpextra {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_phpextra', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_phpextra {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_phpextra', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_phpextra {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_phpextra', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_phpextra PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_phpextra', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_strict empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown_strict', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict+pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict+pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict+footnotes', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict+footnotes'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict+smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict+smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markua empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markua', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markua'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-native empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write native', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write native {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write native {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write native {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write native {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write native PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'native', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-odt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write odt', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt'); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt+empty_paragraphs', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt+empty_paragraphs'); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt+native_numbering', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt+native_numbering'); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt {columns = 30}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt', {columns = 30}); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)
  probe('write odt {reference_links = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'odt', {reference_links = true}); return P.read(bytes, 'odt') end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-opendocument empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write opendocument', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'opendocument'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
